=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Item 2, Implementation Steps — `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1140-1165` | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan points Item 2 at `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1140-1165`, but that range is the shared prompt-assembly/heredoc area, so per-family overlays cannot be wired there as described.
  WHY: The cited range is not the per-model setup site, so the described wiring would land in the wrong place and fail to differentiate reviewers.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Item 6, Implementation Steps — `prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt:1-50` and the claim in Risks & Mitigations that "current sizes: plan = 84, implement = 71, validate-discover = 38" with no mention of validate-generate | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan treats `prompts/mode-validate-generate.txt` as a short edit surface and omits it from the size-budget claim.
  WHY: The file is 809 lines, so the cited `:1-50` range and the budget summary misrepresent the actual edit scope.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Item 5 — "Run independent operations in parallel; serialise only when there is an explicit dependency (matches CLAUDE.md §16 parallel-tool-use guidance)" | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan cites `CLAUDE.md §16` for parallel-tool-use guidance, but that section is about task delegation/model-tier selection.
  WHY: The reference sends implementers to unrelated policy text instead of the actual parallel-operation guidance.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Rollout section, paragraph "the existing reviewer-bundle parser is fail-open per `unattended_system_instructions.md` §14 and the parser tolerates additional prose" | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The rollout text attributes the reviewer-bundle parser fail-open contract to `unattended_system_instructions.md` §14, but that section is GitHub API call hygiene.
  WHY: The cited section does not contain the pipeline contract, so the authoritative location is obscured.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Item 2 — `scripts/render_prompt.sh:1-50` and `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1140-1165` | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The plan relies on exact line numbers for `scripts/render_prompt.sh` and `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh`, but those anchors can shift before implementation.
  WHY: Without stable structural anchors, a later edit can move the target or make the insertion point unfindable.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 9 / Implementation Step 9 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `compact_if_over_budget(sections, budget)` does not define how tokens are counted or whether `body` is pre-rendered text.
  WHY: Different counting methods produce different drop decisions, making the helper's behavior inconsistent.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 5 / Implementation Step 5 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The "no surprise edits affecting more than three files outside the plan's `files_touched` set" rule conflicts with existing lockfile-update discipline.
  WHY: The current implement prompt already requires lockfile changes, so the new rule needs an explicit exception.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 3 / Implementation Step 3 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The six-step gate does not specify what counts as enough evidence for steps that may not apply to trivial tasks.
  WHY: Without a minimum-evidence rule, the model may fabricate filler lines or loop trying to satisfy irrelevant stages.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Risk item "Model-family overlay routing leaks across reviewers" — "existing run_reviewer already spawns each reviewer under an isolated subshell (the `>&2 &` pattern at scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1580); the new env-var export is scoped to that subshell." | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan's isolation rationale for the `MODEL_FAMILY_OVERLAY` export uses `>&2 &` as if it were a subshell.
  WHY: The cited pattern is a backgrounded process/fork, so the terminology and scoping explanation need correction.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 8 / Risk item "Categorised lessons section in agents.md rots" | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The pointer-only lessons section in `agents.md` can go stale silently when the linked targets move.
  WHY: The mitigation is deferred, so the failure mode has no immediate diagnostic signal.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 1 / Implementation Step 1 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The exploration-first gate adds extra reads before writes, increasing prompt/context use.
  WHY: More exploratory reads consume budget and can push the turn closer to wall limits.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Location: Open Questions Q-B | severity=low
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The fallback `other.txt` overlay format does not say how to structure model-specific additions without bloat.
  WHY: Per-model comment headers would make the fallback extensible without creating more overlay files.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Goal 9 / Implementation Step 9 | severity=low
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `body` field in `compact_if_over_budget` is not constrained to resolved in-memory text.
  WHY: If callers pass file paths, the helper cannot measure prompt size without extra file I/O.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Risks & Mitigations — "Six-step gate stalls STATUS: CLEAR" — "the existing MAX_PLAN_TURNS (if any) and EDITOR_MAX_WALL budgets bound the loop" | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The risk mitigation cites `MAX_PLAN_TURNS`, but no such variable exists in the repository.
  WHY: Grep does not find the guardrail, so the claimed budget bound is not real.
- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Summary — "into this repo's unattended prompt set … reviewer fan-out scripts … agents.md operational facts, and CLAUDE.md interactive-session policy" | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The summary/Q3 scope says `CLAUDE.md` is targeted, but no implementation step or file edit includes it.
  WHY: That makes the stated deliverables incomplete and misleading.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- docs/plans/open-agents-learnings-plan.md:Item 2 — `scripts/render_prompt.sh:1-50` and `scripts/review_run_reviewers.sh:1140-1165` | confidence=3
